senses.gloss: (b. h.) to settle, be at rest, at ease.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 88a:6">Sabb. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>למה שָׁקְטָה</he>, v. <cite ref="J00591"><he>יָרֵא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3a:7">Ab. Zar. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 811:1">Yalk. Ps. 811</cite>. Yalk. Hab. 563 <he>ש׳ העולם</he> the world remained undisturbed; Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Sh’mini 10 <he>שקטה הארץ</he>; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Job 34:29">Job XXXIV, 29</cite>) <he>והוא יַשְׁקִיט מעולמו</he> and he (the Lord) is unconcerned about his world; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (not <he>בעולמו</he>).

<cite ref="Gittin 31b:9">Gitt. 31ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 37:17">Job XXXVII, 17</cite>) <he>אימתי … בשעה שה׳ וכ׳</he> (Rashi <he>בשׁמַשְׁקִיט</he>) when are thy clothes warm? When he makes the world rest from the south (when the south wind abates); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 922">Yalk. Job 922</cite>.—[Tosef. Erub. IX (VI), 26 <he>המשקטין</he> Var., v. <cite ref="S02229"><he>קָשַׁט</he></cite>.]
